description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to understand the GEO framework and discover the 8 scoring dimensions. (2) Evaluate plant_protein_draft.md against all 8 dimensions (Definition Clarity, Quotable Statements, Factual Density, Source Citations, Q&A Format, Authority Signals, Content Freshness, Structural Clarity), scoring each 1-5. (3) The article is deliberately weak on all dimensions — it has no citations, no Q&A, no data, no authority signals, no dates, vague claims — so all scores should be 1-2, totalling 8-16/40, placing it in 'Major work needed'. (4) Output must follow the exact SKILL.md format: '## GEO Audit', 'Current Score: X/40', a 'Dimension | Score | Quick Fix' table, '## Optimized Content Sections' with '### Definition (Citable)' using the '[Term] is [category] that [function], [key metric]' template, '### Key Statistics' with bullet-point sourced stats, and '### FAQ Section' with exactly 5-7 questions in '**Q:** ... A: ...' format. The proprietary traps are: the /40 denominator, the exact tier boundaries (16-23 = Major work needed), the 3-column table format with 'Quick Fix', the Definition template structure, and the 5-7 FAQ count requirement.
